Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as 6eead743a27bb1241ab6866d5d3d2327dee46736
@haghera@nvidia.com this patch also adds your ```nvidia.json``` schema to the list 😊
This doesn't end up seeming very helpful since this doesn't tell anyone how to regenerate it (as you've actually generated it with a wrapper)?
Fixed it to pass through the name of the first script which was called 😊

Could we just remove these entirely?  On-device schema generation has been disabled for 6 years now:

https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/commit/8da991909eaceea5a43279e53f093cd305f9cd58

If we want to add it back someday, this list of schema files is probably the least difficult part of it to add back.
/s/On-device schema generation/On-device schema validation/g

What about 
```
xyz.openbmc_project.AddObject                       interface -         -                                        -
.AddObject                                          method    a{sv}     -                                        -
```
? That's currently available and added through ```createAddObjectMethod```

which then calls ```configuration::validateJson(schema, newData)```

which then does the schema validation.

So there is still a code path using the installed schemas.

Not sure if ```AddObject``` has any user somwewhere, do we still need it?
Closing this discussion thread since there has not been any response in 7 days.
ACK.  I wasn't aware that path called it.
80 char limit doesn't look like it applies to sh?  Weird.
Sounds like a good addition for the ```openbmc-build-scripts```
